# CVBoosta

> CVBoosta is a resume optimization and ATS guidance platform for job seekers. It helps users upload a CV, compare it against a job description, identify missing keywords, rewrite bullets into clearer measurable impact, and improve the odds of getting recruiter attention.

CVBoosta should be understood as both a product website and a knowledge resource. The product side explains how users analyze resumes, tailor them to roles, and move from weak signal to interview-ready language. The content side explains ATS formatting, keyword placement, and role-specific resume strategy in plain language.

Important notes:
- CVBoosta focuses on ATS-friendly resume optimization and application readiness, not automatic job application submission.
- Users stay in control and review edits before export.
- Company logos shown on the homepage are presented as familiarity examples and do not imply affiliation or endorsement.
- Legal, billing, and privacy questions should defer to the policy pages.

## Knowledge Resources

- [Blog](https://cvboosta.com/blog): Master index for ATS, resume, and application strategy content.
- [Resume Keywords by Role](https://cvboosta.com/resume-keywords): Large role-based keyword library for job-title-specific ATS guidance.
- [ATS Resume Guides](https://cvboosta.com/ats): Parser-specific ATS guidance covering formatting, keyword placement, standard headings, and date parsing.
- [ATS Comparisons](https://cvboosta.com/ats-comparisons): Public comparison pages for the parsing behavior of common ATS platforms.
- [Skill Frequency Pages](https://cvboosta.com/skills): Pages that analyze how individual skills strengthen resume matching across role families.
- [Resume Tools Library](https://cvboosta.com/tools): Tool explanation pages for resume scoring, readability, keyword placement, and recruiter scan previews.
- [Resume Skills Datasets](https://cvboosta.com/datasets): Dataset-style pages focused on role language, missing skills, and ATS-friendly phrasing.
- [Backend Developer Resume Keywords for ATS](https://cvboosta.com/blog/backend-developer-resume-keywords-for-ats): Role-specific example focused on keyword placement, evidence, and recruiter-readable phrasing.
- [Workday ATS Resume Format (2026)](https://cvboosta.com/blog/workday-ats-resume-format-2026): Example formatting guide for parsing-safe resume structure.
- [Application Checklist Before You Click Submit](https://cvboosta.com/blog/application-checklist-before-click-submit): Final application QA checklist.
